compression.brotliSizeHint: input bytes for each before/after buffer

algorithm: With Node 24.22.0, read the single dist/assets/*.css file as a Buffer; retain the original bytes without rewriting the file.
Decode that Buffer as UTF-8; require exactly one occurrence of rule.text, whose UTF-8 byte length must be 52.
Create an in-memory after Buffer using Buffer.from(text.replace(rule.text, ""), "utf8").
For each before/after Buffer, calculate raw=buffer.byteLength, SHA-256=createHash("sha256").update(buffer).digest("hex"), and gzip=gzipSync(buffer,{level:9}).byteLength.
Calculate delta for each metric as before minus after; require the after SHA-256 to equal the baseline JSON runs[0].files[0].sha256.
Write only this attribution JSON. The emitted CSS and both baseline/candidate evidence files are read-only inputs.
